items.title: Russischer Angriff auf Komyschuwacha: 53 Leichen geborgen
items.teaser: In Dorf Komyschuwacha im Gebiet Saporischschja dauern Such- und Rettungsarbeiten nach einem russischen Luftangriff vom 2. November an. Bislang wurden 53 Leichen aus den Trümmern geborgen.

items.title: Ukrainian forces strike Russian ammunition depots in Zaporizhzhia, Donetsk regions
items.teaser: Ukraine's Defense Forces struck two Russian ammunition depots in the Zaporizhzhia region on November 5 and overnight into November 6, as well as an enemy drone command post and a fuel and lubricant depot in the Donetsk region.

items.title: They turned a park into a mortar firing range: Ukraine's Defence Intelligence reveals how Russians are destroying Ukrainian nature reserves
items.teaser: Defence Intelligence of Ukraine says Russian forces have set up a mortar range in Pryazovia National Nature Park and destroyed bird nesting sites in Meotyda park.

items.title: Ukraine: Trump stellt "sehr großes" Abkommen mit Russland in Aussicht
items.teaser: Der US-Präsident hat in Washington einen Kreml-Berater empfangen. Donald Trumps anschließendes Statement dürfte für Unruhe in der Ukraine und Europa sorgen.

items.title: Bodies of 53 people recovered from rubble of underground school in Komyshuvakha
items.teaser: Search and rescue operations are continuing at the site of the November 2 airstrike in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia region. So far, rescuers have recovered the bodies of 53 people.

items.title: Finland defense minister calls for burden sharing on defense and Ukraine, for the sake of European unity
items.teaser: Finland's Defense Minister Antti Hakkanen said European countries should commit at least 0.25% of GDP in support of Ukraine, which Kyiv has identified as the right percentage to keep it financially afloat.

items.title: Tillschneider als "Nazi" bezeichnet? Staatsanwaltschaft stellt Ermittlungen ein
items.teaser: Ist AfD-Politiker Tillschneider am Rande des Gedenkens an den Anschlag von Halle als "Nazi" beleidigt worden? Die Staatsanwaltschaft hat ihre Ermittlungen dazu abgeschlossen.

items.title: Generalstab meldet 188 Gefechte an der Front in den vergangenen 24 Stunden, die intensivsten - bei Pokrowsk
items.teaser: In den vergangenen 24 Stunden haben entlang der Front 188 Zusammenstöße zwischen den ukrainischen und russischen Streitkräften stattgefunden, teilt der ukrainische Generalstab auf Facebook mit.

items.title: Russian forces attack energy facilities in Kirovohrad region
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked energy facilities in the Kirovohrad region overnight and early on November 6.

items.title: They got the labs running again after Izium was liberated: Russian strike kills five women who worked at disease control centre
items.teaser: Five women who worked at a branch of the Kharkiv Oblast Centre for Disease Control and Prevention were killed in a Russian guided aerial bomb attack on the city of Izium on 29 October. They had been among the first to return to work after Izium was liberated from Russian occupation.

items.title: A Russian refinery rated at more than 6 million tons a year burns again in Krasnodar Krai
items.teaser: Estimates of the plant’s capacity vary, but it is consistently listed among the largest in southern Russia.

items.title: Ukrainian forces hit two Russian ammunition storage points in occupied parts of Zaporizhzhia Oblast
items.teaser: Ukrainian units have struck two Russian ammunition storage points in Zaporizhzhia Oblast, as well as a UAV ground control station and a fuel depot in Donetsk Oblast.

items.title: Man killed in Russian morning attack on Rivne region, damage reported
items.teaser: A man was killed in a Russian attack on the Sarny district, Rivne region, on Friday morning.

items.title: Death toll from Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia Oblast school reaches 53
items.teaser: The death toll from the Russian attack on a school in the settlement of Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia Oblast, on 2 November has risen to 53.

items.title: Two police officers injured in Russian jet-powered drone attack on Derhachi – photo
items.teaser: Two police officers were injured when Russian forces used a jet-powered drone to strike the city of Derhachi in Kharkiv Oblast on the evening of 5 November.

items.title: Nach mehreren Klinikaufenthalten : Seniorin stirbt elf Monate nach Anschlag am Bondi Beach
items.teaser: Ende des vergangenen Jahres verüben ein Vater und sein Sohn aus antisemitischen Motiven einen Anschlag am Bondi Beach in Sydney. Einer der Angreifer wird von der Polizei erschossen, der andere muss sich vor Gericht verantworten. Nun steigt die Zahl der Todesopfer auf 16.

items.title: Five people injured in Russian drone attacks in Kyiv region over past day
items.teaser: Five people were injured and a dormitory at an educational institution was damaged in Russian drone attacks in the Kyiv region over the past 24 hours.

items.title: Zelenskyy reveals amount of undelivered US aid
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has stated that Ukraine has not received US$16 billion in American aid envisaged by previous agreements.

items.title: Energieanlagen in Region Kyjiw bei nächtlichem russischem Angriff beschädigt, es gibt drei Verletzte
items.teaser: In der Hauptstadtregion werden Folgen des nächtlichen russischem Angriffs in drei Bezirken festgestellt, teilt der Leiter der regionalen Militärverwaltung, Tymur Tkagtschenko, auf Telegram mit.

items.title: EU's Costa backs Meloni's criticism of peace talks 'disarray,' plans to fix it
items.teaser: "I take note of your request to discuss this matter further at the forthcoming informal European Council meeting in Dublin, and I will make time for this discussion," wrote European Council President Antonio Costa.

items.title: Ukraine still unable to obtain details from US on allocation of US$400m in military aid
items.teaser: Ukraine has yet to receive information from the US on how the Pentagon will spend US$400 million in military aid, despite repeated requests for clarification.

items.title: Donald Trump kündigt "großes Abkommen" mit Russland an
items.teaser: US-Präsident Trump kündigt nach einem Treffen mit einem russischen Unterhändler ein Abkommen zum Ukraine-Krieg an. Es könne ganz Europa betreffen. Details nennt er nicht.

items.title: Drones attack Afipsky Oil Refinery in Russia's Krasnodar Krai, fire breaks out – media
items.teaser: On the night of Friday, November 6, a group of drones attacked the Afipsky Oil Refinery in Krasnodar Krai, southern Russia.

items.title: Brand in russischer Ölraffinerie nach Drohnenangriff
items.teaser: In der Nacht auf Freitag, den 6. November, haben Drohnen die Afipskij-Ölraffinerie in der südrussischen Region Krasnodar attackiert, wie der Telegram-Kanal ASTRA berichtet.

items.title: „24“ wird 25: Jack Bauer prägt die TV-Landschaft bis heute
items.teaser: „Ich bin Federal Agent Jack Bauer. Das ist der längste Tag meines Lebens“: Von denen hatte „24“-Star Kiefer Sutherland noch so einige. Erstmals raunte er diesen Satz aber vor genau 25 Jahren.

items.title: General Duka threatened detectives with gun and damaged equipment as Alpha unit shielded him – anti-corruption bureau
items.teaser: NABU has reported that during a search, SSU General Serhii Duka threatened detectives with a gun and smashed equipment with a hammer, while Alpha unit fighters tried to evacuate him.

items.title: Russian night attack damages energy infrastructure in Kyiv region, three injured
items.teaser: The consequences of a Russian overnight attack were reported in three districts of the Kyiv region, with three people injured.

items.title: Akim, Price, Boxer, and Criminal: Ukraine’s latest wiretaps read like a mob movie, with real officials in the cast
items.teaser: A security service general, a senior police officer, and an alleged enforcer are among five suspects, and judges have already ordered two of them held while the general still waits for his ruling.

items.title: Luftwaffe: 196 russische Drohnen unschädlich gemacht
items.teaser: Die ukrainischen Luftstreitkräfte haben ihren eigenen Angaben zufolge 196 Drohnen, mit denen Russland die Ukraine in der Nacht auf den 6. November angegriffen hat, abgewehrt.

items.title: ADF neutralizes 196 Russian drones used to attack Ukraine overnight
items.teaser: Ukraine’s air defense forces neutralized 196 drones used by Russian forces to attack the country beginning on the evening of November 5.

items.title: War update: 188 combat engagements on front line over past day
items.teaser: A total of 188 combat engagements took place between Ukraine's Defense Forces and Russian troops over the past 24 hours. Russian forces applied the greatest pressure in the Pokrovsk direction.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,601,830 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 2,440 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: Zuerst überflog ein US-Spionageflugzeug den Suwalki-Korridor – danach umkreiste es die russische Exklave Kaliningrad
items.teaser: Ein US-Aufklärungsflugzeug hat erneut eine Mission nahe Kaliningrad geflogen. Die Artemis II überquerte dabei zweimal den Suwałki-Korridor.

items.title: 2440 Soldaten: Russlands Verluste seit gestern
items.teaser: Die Zahl der getöteten oder verletzten russischen Soldaten ist seit dem 24. Februar 2022 auf 1. 601. 830 gestiegen. Allein innerhalb von 24 Stunden beträgt die Zahl der Verluste 2440.

items.title: Russia drones attack five districts of Dnipropetrovsk region overnight
items.teaser: Russian forces carried out more than ten drone attacks against five districts of the Dnipropetrovsk region, causing damage to several locations.

items.title: Russian forces attack energy infrastructure facility in Mykolaiv region
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked an energy infrastructure facility in the Mykolaiv region yesterday using a Geran-type attack drone.

items.title: Russian army loses 2,440 troops in war against Ukraine over past day
items.teaser: The total estimated combat losses of Russian forces in the war against Ukraine from February 24, 2022, to November 6, 2026, have reached approximately 1,601,830 personnel, including 2,440 troops lost over the past 24 hours.

items.title: Russia attacks Ukraine with 227 drones
items.teaser: Russia launched 227 attack drones overnight. Around 15 drones were still in the air as of 08:00.

items.title: Trump trifft Kreml-Vertreter und stellt Abkommen in Aussicht
items.teaser: Sowohl Vertreter Russlands als auch der Ukraine waren jetzt zu Gast im Weißen Haus. Doch den US-Präsidenten persönlich durfte nur der Kreml-Gesandte treffen. Anschließend kündigte Trump einen möglichen Deal an, nannte aber keine Details.

items.title: Zelensky outlines main topics of negotiations between teams in Brussels
items.teaser: Security guarantees for Ukraine and preparations for a trilateral meeting in Abu Dhabi were the key topics of negotiations held in Brussels on November 4–5.

items.title: Ukraine to propose expanding Oleshky evacuation experience to other occupied territories in talks with U.S. and Russia – Zelensky
items.teaser: Ukraine will propose to the United States and Russia that the evacuation efforts carried out in Oleshky be expanded to other occupied territories.

items.title: Ukrainian citizen killed at hotel in Slovakia: Police open murder investigation

items.title: Russia loses 2,440 soldiers and 54 artillery systems over past day
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff has updated data on Russian losses: Russia lost 2,440 soldiers killed and wounded over the past day.

items.title: Trump announces 'big deal' that concerns Ukraine and all of Europe
items.teaser: The U.S. president said that a major agreement could be reached in the near future, one that would concern not only Ukraine but Europe as a whole.

items.title: Ukrainian forces target oil refinery as explosions reported across southern Russia
items.teaser: A Russian oil refinery was set ablaze as a Ukrainian drone attack set off fires and explosions across southern Russia overnight on Nov. 6, monitoring channels reported.

items.title: Afipsky oil refinery in Russia's Krasnodar Krai targeted in attack, fire breaks out – photos
items.teaser: Explosions were heard at one of southern Russia's largest refineries, with thick smoke later seen drifting towards Krasnodar. The attack has not been officially confirmed.

items.title: Defense Forces neutralize more than 90% of Russian Lancet and Molniya drones in one week
items.teaser: Russian forces deployed 7,947 Lancet and Molniya attack drones at the tactical level between October 29 and November 4. Ukraine's Defense Forces neutralized nearly 91% of them.

items.title: Prosecutor General's Office investigating deaths of 241 Ukrainians in Russian captivity
items.teaser: Law enforcement officials are investigating 241 cases of Ukrainians dying in Russian captivity. The dead include 230 prisoners of war and 11 civilians.

items.title: Trump meets Russian envoy in Washington ahead of Ukraine peace talks, claims 'big, beautiful agreement' coming
items.teaser: "There's going to be an agreement. It's going to be a big agreement, and it's going to involve more than Ukraine," U.S. President Donald Trump said.

items.title: Meloni urges EU to agree on representative for Ukraine peace talks
items.teaser: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has called on the European Union to decide who will represent the bloc in negotiations on ending Russia's war against Ukraine and what mandate its representative will have.

items.title: Trump's envoy Kushner: US to hold peace talks with Ukraine and Russia next week
items.teaser: Jared Kushner says Washington has prepared proposals for discussions aimed at ending the war and establishing long-term security arrangements for Ukraine and Europe.

items.title: Ukrainian troops capture Russian soldier wearing Ukrainian military uniform
items.teaser: Operators of the 3rd Detachment of the 4th Ranger Regiment of the Special Operations Forces (SOF) captured a Russian serviceman who was disguised in a Ukrainian Armed Forces uniform.

items.title: Finland sentences Fitburg captain and boatswain to prison over damage to Gulf of Finland cables
items.teaser: The Helsinki District Court has sentenced the captain and boatswain of the vessel Fitburg to prison terms in connection with damage to undersea cables in the Gulf of Finland late last year.

items.title: Ukraine needs to consolidate 'bipartisan support' in US following midterm elections, Zelensky says
items.teaser: With Democrats set to control the U.S. Senate and House of Representatives come 2027, Zelensky said Ukraine now has "increased chances" of securing additional aid.

items.teaser: Attending the 30th Ibero-American Summit, Zelensky said the funds will help bolster Ukrainian air defenses as Russian strikes pummel Ukrainian transportation and energy infrastructure.

items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky believes that following the U.S. elections, Ukraine should seek to secure $16 billion in aid from the United States that was previously suspended.

items.teaser: Volodymyr Zelenskyy has announced a new Spanish military aid package worth €437 million following talks with Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez.

items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said he had received a positive response to the proposal to allocate an additional EUR 70 billion to Ukraine for 2027 following his meeting with European Council President Antonio Costa.

items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy hopes that following the US midterm elections, the balance of power will stabilise and Ukraine will receive more support.

items.teaser: "We would like you to keep going and find new missions and de-escalate as much as possible," David Arakhamia, the head of President Volodymyr Zelensky's parliamentary group, told the first lady. "Your mission is above politics."

items.title: Ukrainian woman dies in illegal Russian detention in Crimea
items.teaser: Oleksandra Kazarovytska, who was 44 years old, had returned to occupied Sevastopol to help her parents sell their apartment, according to the statement of the Kharkiv language school where she served as director of studies.

items.title: Russian forces attack manufacturing facility in Kyiv Oblast, injuring two people
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked a manufacturing and warehouse facility in Kyiv Oblast on 5 November, injuring two people and damaging nearby buildings.

items.title: Zelensky urges Latin American countries and Spain to help restore Ukraine's energy system
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has called on Latin American countries and Spain to urgently help supply Ukraine with transformers, cables, generators and other electrical equipment to restore its energy system following Russian attacks.

items.title: Ukrainian businesses allowed to share air defence systems and protect each other's facilities
items.teaser: The Ukrainian government has allowed businesses with their own air defence groups to protect other companies' facilities under contracts.

items.title: Oleshky’s evacuation was called a success, but some residents didn’t make it out. Now, the aid is still not reaching them
items.teaser: Some people hid in basements without a signal and never learned there was a way out, the town’s Ukrainian administration says.

items.title: Senior Ukrainian law enforcement officials charged in sprawling scam call centers case
items.teaser: Accoridng to Ukraine's anti-corruption agencies, the group was also involved in torture-for-hire, kidnappings, extorting millions of dollars, and other crimes.

items.title: Video zeigt russischen Drohnenangriff auf Feuerwehrleute während eines laufenden Löscheinsatzes in Slowjansk
items.teaser: In der Stadt Slowjansk im Gebiet Donezk hat eine russische Drohne Feuerwehrleute angegriffen, während diese einen durch russischen Beschuss verursachten Brand löschen.

items.title: Finnisches Gericht verurteilt Kapitän aus Russland und ein weiteres Besatzungsmitglied wegen Sabotage an Ostseekabeln: 1,9 Millionen Euro Strafe
items.teaser: Ende 2025 haben Unbekannte wichtige Tiefseekabel in der Ostsee beschädigt. Die finnische Regierung nahm ein Schiff mit russischem Kapitän ins Visier. Jetzt wurde der verurteilt.

items.title: Ukrainian and Slovak PMs agree on establishment of bilingual schools
items.teaser: During a visit to Lviv, Slovak Prime Minister Robert Fico and Ukrainian Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi signed an intergovernmental Agreement on establishing bilingual gymnasiums in both countries.

items.title: Melania Trump delivers personal letters to Zelenskyy and Putin through Ukrainian MP and Russian envoy
items.teaser: US First Lady Melania Trump has delivered personal letters to Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and Russian leader Vladimir Putin.

items.title: Hungarian Foreign Ministry considers Ukraine's EU accession by 2030 unrealistic
items.teaser: Hungarian Foreign Minister Anita Orbán has stated that Budapest does not consider Ukraine's accession to the European Union by 2030 to be realistic, ruling out any accelerated process.

items.title: Security guarantees for Ukraine top agenda of talks in Brussels – Umerov
items.teaser: Security guarantees for Ukraine and a new European security strategy were the main topics of meetings in Brussels on November 5 with representatives of France, the United Kingdom, Germany, the United States and NATO.

items.title: Ukraine: Korruption und Mafiastrukturen bei Geheimdienst und Polizei?
items.teaser: Ukrainische Antikorruptionsbehörden haben neue Ermittlungsergebnisse veröffentlicht, die schockieren: Der Korruptionsskandal zieht offenbar noch weitere Kreise als bisher bekannt - und betrifft auch Geheimdienst und Polizei. Von F. Kellermann.

items.title: Slovakia to provide Ukraine with 54 generators, funds for shelters and medical equipment
items.teaser: Slovakia will provide Ukraine with an energy assistance package, including 54 generators, as well as funds for the Civil Protection Shelter Coalition and medical equipment.

items.title: Koretskyi, Fico sign Ukraine-Slovakia cooperation agreement in Lviv
items.teaser: Ukraine and Slovakia have signed a joint declaration on cooperation setting out all existing practical agreements and planned projects.

items.title: Security guarantees for Ukraine discussed with US and European officials in Brussels
items.teaser: Representatives of Ukraine, the US, France, the UK, Germany, and NATO have held a working meeting in Brussels to discuss future security guarantees.

items.title: Deutschland hat seit Kriegsbeginn 36 Tausend Energiegüter an Ukraine übergeben
items.teaser: Seit Beginn der Vollinvasion Russlands haben deutsche Unternehmen den ukrainischen Energieversorgern über 36.000 Energiegüter zur Unterstützung beim Wiederaufbau der Energieinfrastruktur bereitgestellt, teilt das ukrainische Energieministerium auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Five suspects in Carthage case notified of charges, including senior SBU and National Police officials
items.teaser: Detectives from the National Anti-Corruption Bureau of Ukraine (NABU) have notified five alleged members of a criminal organization of suspicion. The organization was exposed the previous day as part of Operation Carthage.

items.title: Emergency power outages introduced in Dnipro, scheduled cuts suspended
items.teaser: Emergency power outages have been introduced in the city of Dnipro by order of Ukrenergo, meaning hourly scheduled power cuts are currently suspended.

items.title: Police find missing woman alive four days after Russian bombing of Komyshuvakha underground school. Death toll rises to 43.
items.teaser: Russia dropped multiple aerial bombs, including a three-ton FAB-3000, on an underground school in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia Oblast, while civilians gathered to receive humanitarian aid. At least 43 people were killed.

items.title: Zelensky, Costa discuss preparations for Abu Dhabi meeting, Ukraine's EU integration
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and European Council President Antonio Costa have discussed the possibility of completing all negotiating clusters on Ukraine's EU accession by the end of this year and moving on to closing individual negotiating chapters next year.

items.title: Fico downplays prospect of Slovakia hosting peace talks during Lviv visit
items.teaser: Fico's latest comments seemingly downplay the suggestion made by his foreign minister, Juraj Blanar, who proposed Bratislava as a venue for preparatory peace talks after his visit to Moscow last week.

items.title: Three more Russian commanders served with notices of suspicion over Okhmatdyt missile strike
items.teaser: Ukrainian law enforcement has served notices of suspicion in absentia on three more Russian commanders involved in the deadly missile strike on the Okhmatdyt children's hospital in Kyiv.

items.title: US Democrats planning to investigate Musk's actions over Starlink throttling for Ukraine, CNN reports
items.teaser: The US Senate Foreign Relations Committee has sent letters to Elon Musk to preserve documents ahead of a planned investigation into the throttling of Starlink in Ukraine.

items.title: Russen haben 2185 Kulturstätten in der Ukraine seit Kriegsbeginn beschädigt
items.teaser: Bis Ende Oktober sind in der Ukraine 2185 Kulturstätten infolge der russischen Aggression beschädigt worden.

items.title: Zelensky on new EUR 4.36B EU tranche: Funds will go toward energy, air defense, drones
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky thanked the European Union for allocating EUR 4.36 billion to Ukraine and said the funds would be used to strengthen the energy sector and air defenses and to purchase drones and electronic warfare equipment.

items.title: Police, SBU identify 130 people potentially involved in clashes near National Guard facility in Kyiv Oblast
items.teaser: Of the 130 people identified, 27 allegedly "took an active part in unlawful actions," while another 24 "acted aggressively, incited others, and deliberately provoked confrontations" with police and National Guard personnel, according to the National Police.

items.title: Notice of suspicion served on woman, 22, who tried to overturn National Guard bus during clashes in Kyiv Oblast
items.teaser: A 22-year-old woman involved in the unrest in Petropavlivska Borshchahivka, Kyiv Oblast, has been served with a notice of suspicion for obstructing the Armed Forces.

items.title: Mitglied der Schattenflotte?: Kapitän nach Kabel-Sabotage in der Ostsee verurteilt
items.teaser: Seit dem Beginn des Ukraine-Kriegs ist auch die Ostsee Schauplatz des Konflikts. Immer wieder werden wichtige Kabel und Leitungen beschädigt. Nun hat Finnland zwei Seeleute wegen Sabotage zu mehrjährigen Haftstrafen verurteilt.

items.title: Mathernova urges Ukraine to speed up reforms, warns EU enlargement 'window of opportunity' may close
items.teaser: Ukraine's Verkhovna Rada should speed up the adoption of necessary reforms, as the current "window of opportunity" for Ukraine to advance towards EU membership will not remain open indefinitely.

items.title: HACC remands senior National Police official Tsenov in custody, sets bail at UAH 15M
items.teaser: Ukraine's High Anti-Corruption Court (HACC) has ordered Volodymyr Tsenov, First Deputy Head of the Strategic Investigations Department of the National Police of Ukraine, to be held in custody, with the option of posting bail set at UAH 15 million.

items.title: Inside Republican watch parties, some blame midterm failure on Trump's unkept promises — including Ukraine
items.teaser: WASHINGTON, United States — "It is a funeral," a conservative voter from South Carolina said, gesturing toward the crowd inside the Butterworth, a restaurant in the heart of Washington that has long been favored by members and supporters of the Republican Party. It is where Washington Republicans come

items.title: Zelensky discusses return of Ukrainian children abducted by Russia with Andorran PM
items.teaser: In Madrid, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky discussed joint efforts to bring back Ukrainian children abducted by Russia with Andorran Prime Minister Xavier Espot Zamora.

items.title: Crimea’s lights go out again—and Ukraine says two more Pantsirs were hit
items.teaser: Russia’s Energy Ministry claims a Ukrainian attack cut Crimea’s power on 4 November—the second straight night the peninsula lost supply.

items.title: Selenskyj: Zahl der Toten nach russischem Angriff auf Komyschuwacha steigt auf 43
items.teaser: Die Zahl der Toten nach einem russischen Angriff auf das Dorf Komyschuwacha im Gebiet Saporischschja ist auf 43 gestiegen.

items.title: Ukraine's anti-corruption court orders probe into prominent Zelensky ally
items.teaser: When asked about the corruption allegations, David Arakhamia, head of President Volodymyr Zelensky's parliamentary faction, told the Kyiv Independent that he "hadn't had time to look into the matter."

items.title: EU überweist Ukraine 4,36 Milliarden Euro für Stärkung finanzieller Resilienz
items.teaser: Die Europäische Kommission hat der Ukraine eine weitere Tranche von 4,36 Milliarden Euro im Rahmen des Unterstützungsdarlehens Ukraine Support Loan überwiesen, das für die Jahre 2026-2027 vorgesehen ist.

items.title: A Kyiv-bound Shahed carried a warhead and leaflets touting a “Ukrainian” brigade in Russia’s army
items.teaser: Ukrainian troops downed it on 4 November. A second leaflet in the bundle attacked Ukraine’s military recruitment offices.

items.title: Woman reported missing after Russian attack on Komyshuvakha found alive
items.teaser: A 56-year-old woman who had been reported missing following a Russian attack on Komyshuvakha has been found alive.

items.title: Water supply disruptions return in Kyiv, metro service temporarily suspended due to power fluctuations
items.teaser: Kyivvodokanal, the municipal utility responsible for water supply and wastewater services in Kyiv and the surrounding region, said at around 1:30 p.m. local time that power outages at its facilities had disrupted water supplies across all districts of the capital.

items.title: Kharkiv teacher dies in pre-trial detention centre in occupied Crimea
items.teaser: Oleksandra Kazarovytska was detained in Sevastopol after travelling to Crimea to help her parents. Russian occupation authorities claim she took her own life.

items.title: EU allocates nearly EUR 1B for winter support of Ukraine's energy sector – Mathernova
items.teaser: The European Union has earmarked nearly EUR 1 billion to support Ukraine's energy sector this winter.

items.title: Head of Zelenskyy's Office Budanov on high-profile corruption revelations involving law enforcement officials: Decisive action needed
items.teaser: Head of Ukraine's President's Office Kyrylo Budanov calls for decisive action following corruption revelations involving senior law enforcement officials in Operation Carthage.

items.title: Das sagt Selenskyj bei Böhmermann über Elon Musk
items.teaser: Jan Böhmermann hat mit dem ukrainischen Präsidenten Selenskyj gesprochen. Sein ungewöhnlicher Weg vom Comedian zum Präsidenten, die Midterms in den USA und Elon Musk waren Thema.

items.title: EU divided over "associate membership" idea that Germany's Merz proposed for Ukraine, Politico says
items.teaser: Germany keeps pushing "associate member" status for Ukraine while von der Leyen floats the term for Canada, deepening a rift between Berlin and Brussels, Politico says.

items.title: Litwinenko-Witwe: "Der Westen hat einen großen Fehler gemacht"
items.teaser: Vor 20 Jahren wurde der russische Ex-Agent Litwinenko in London vergiftet. Seine Witwe treibt heute vor allem eins um: Hat der Westen mit seiner zaghaften Reaktion damals Putins heutige Aggression ermutigt? Von Mareike Aden.

items.title: Zivile und kritische Infrastruktur in Region Winnyzja bei russischem Angriff beschädigt, es gibt Verletzte
items.teaser: In mehreren Gemeinden der Region Winnyzja wurden am 5. November durch einen russischen Angriff zivile und kritische Infrastruktur beschädigt, drei Personen wurden verletzt.

items.title: Putin places Japanese company's assets under "temporary management"
items.teaser: Following moves against European brands such as Metro and Auchan, Moscow has placed JTI's Russian assets under the state-managed entity Promyslovye Aktivy.

items.title: Death toll from Russian airstrike on Komyshuvakha rises to 43 – Zelensky
items.teaser: The death toll from a Russian airstrike on Komyshuvakha in the Zaporizhzhia region has risen to 43.

items.title: The Expiry of MINURSO’s Mandate, Western Sahara, and the Foundations of International Law
items.teaser: Last Friday, on 30 October 2026, the UN Security Council failed to renew the mandate of the UN’s Mission for the Referendum in Western Sahara (MINURSO), bringing to an end an international presence that has lasted since 1991. In terms of immediate consequences, this could have considerable ramifications on the ground,

items.title: Selenskyj bei Böhmermann: "Es muss ein würdevolles Ende sein"
items.teaser: Im ZDF-Interview spricht Selenskyj über US-Unterstützung, Elon Musk und seine Hoffnung auf ein würdiges Ende des Kriegs mit Russland.

items.title: Russian drone attacks firefighters while they battle blaze in Sloviansk
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked firefighters with a drone while they were extinguishing a fire in Sloviansk.

items.title: Russen greifen erneut Energieobjekte an, in Kyjiw und vier Regionen Stromausfälle gemeldet
items.teaser: Nach dem russischen Drohnen- und Raketenangriff wurden am Montag dem 5. November in der Hauptstadt Kyjiw und vier Regionen der Ukraine Stromausfälle gemeldet.

items.title: Water supply disruptions reported across all districts of Kyiv due to power outages
items.teaser: Emergency power outages have caused disruptions to water supply in all districts of Kyiv.

items.title: Russian milblogger urges hitting Ukraine’s nuclear plants. ISW: without stronger defenses, last winter will likely repeat
items.teaser: Ukraine’s nuclear plants have already cut output because the damaged grid cannot carry their power.

items.title: Lithuania's Foreign Ministry summons Russian diplomat over attacks on Ukraine
items.teaser: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Lithuania summoned a representative of the Russian Embassy to condemn attacks on civilian facilities and critical infrastructure in Ukraine.

items.title: Schäden an Unterseekabeln in der Ostsee: Urteil gegen russischen Kapitän
items.teaser: Zehn Monate nach der Sabotage an zwei Kabeln in der Ostsee sind ein russischer Kapitän und ein Crewmitglied in Finnland zu mehrjährigen Haftstrafen verurteilt worden. Sie sollen die Unterseekabel vorsätzlich mit einem Anker beschädigt haben.

items.title: Lived in occupation, fought against Ukraine. Now, Kyiv says, Russia won’t take them back.
items.teaser: Kyiv says it would trade those who ask to go to Russia for Ukrainian defenders. Moscow claims it just won back 50 such men.

items.title: Russian forces strike civilian and critical infrastructure in Vinnytsia region, injuring three
items.teaser: Several communities in Ukraine's Vinnytsia region sustained damage to civilian and critical infrastructure during a Russian attack on November 5. Three people were reported injured.

items.title: Water supply problems reported across Kyiv
items.teaser: Emergency power cuts caused water supply problems in every Kyiv district; Kyivvodokanal says supply is gradually being restored and pump kiosks are available.

items.title: A record EU assessment despite stalled reforms: what's behind Brussels' optimism on Ukraine
items.teaser: Brussels believes that Ukrainian MPs will come to their senses and realise that, through their actions and inaction, Ukraine is allowing Moldova to overtake it on the path to EU membership.

items.title: Police identify 130 participants in Petropavlivska Borshchahivka clashes – video
items.teaser: Ukrainian law enforcement identifies 130 individuals linked to clashes in Petropavlivska Borshchahivka, citing 27 active rioters and 24 aggressive provocateurs.

items.title: Defense Forces strike Russian attack drone launch site, military depots
items.teaser: On November 4 and overnight into November 5, units of Ukraine's Defense Forces struck a launch site for attack drones, Russian military depots, enemy mobile fire groups and repair units.

items.title: Russian attacks kill nine civilians in Kherson, Donetsk, Zaporizhzhia, and Sumy oblasts in a day
items.teaser: Bombs and drones hit homes across front-line communities, while the death toll from Monday's strike on an aid point in Komyshuvakha kept rising.

items.title: Geheimdienst: 15 von 38 wichtigsten russischen Ölraffinerien außer Betrieb bis Ende September
items.teaser: Die ukrainischen Streitkräfte haben bis Ende September 15 von 38 wichtigsten russischen Ölraffinerien außer Betrieb gesetzt.

items.title: Spionage für Russland? - Mehrere Festnahmen in Polen gemeldet
items.teaser: Polnische Ermittler haben mehrere Menschen unter dem Verdacht der Agententätigkeit für Russland festgenommen.

items.title: Zelensky: Increased US aid can force Putin to reconsider plans to continue war
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky hopes that a Democratic victory in the U.S. midterm elections will lead to increased American military and financial assistance for Ukraine. He believes this could influence Putin's decision on whether to continue the war and bring peace negotiations closer.

items.title: Razzien in drei Regionen: Polens Geheimdienst nimmt mutmaßliche russische Agenten fest
items.teaser: Sechs mutmaßliche Agenten sollen für Russland in Polen Waffenkomponenten beschafft haben. Der polnische Inlandsgeheimdienst fasst sie während einer großangelegten Operation. Vier der Verdächtigen wird auch Spionage vorgeworfen.

items.title: Ukraine receives €4.36bn from EU after adopting reforms
items.teaser: Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi has said Ukraine received €4.36 billion from the EU, including €3.7 billion in macro-financial aid and €660 million for defence.
